profile: release / fat LTO / one codegen unit
notes: Three serial desktop repetitions for each Scorched mode; one serial Picade run per mode. Spacewars and existing benchmark timings are single-run smoke comparisons.
Scorched runs use seed 42, 120 simulated seconds, 60 seconds of health-independent bombardment and a 60-second tail, 192 grains, and full replay with per-second hashes.
The tail begins when launches stop; existing shells can still impact. Timing excludes audit, observation, replay and rendering.

Picade kiosk stayed paused, checked before and after each run. Telemetry samples are temperature millidegrees C, scaling_cur_freq kHz and undervoltage alarm; endpoint probes cannot rule out intervening throttling.

Final bank shedding watches a 2-cell halo; default repose 50 degrees, yield delay .35s, scan cadence .1s, 64 candidates, 4096 tracked, 4 releases/transaction, and automatic-shedding population ceiling 48. It never raises the 192-grain impact pool.
Baseline shared code is pre-slumping; its Scorched harness already includes the bombardment fixture and stronger observation hash from 9327948.

Binaries were copied into separate baseline/current directories. A Cargo cache collision after sharing a target directory was resolved by cleaning and rebuilding affected release packages; final binaries were checked for new options/diagnostics before measurement.
